ANALYSIS: Lambert‑Eaton myasthenic syndrome is a neuromuscular junction paraneoplastic disorder; bronchogenic (primary) lung cancer is a distinct diagnosis (though small‑cell lung carcinoma can be an underlying cause of LEMS). They are not the same clinical diagnosis.

VERDICT: INCORRECT
